name: Empty state
summary: What a list, table or screen shows when it has nothing yet. It explains why and gives one next step.

anatomy.purpose: Says what is empty, max 40 characters.
One sentence on why, or what to do.

whenToUse: Any screen that can have zero items.
whenNotToUse: Errors that block the whole page: use an error page.

accessibility.role: none or a status region for dynamic changes
keyboard: Action button is the first focusable item.
accessibility.focus: Move focus to the heading if the state appears after an action.
notes: Illustrations are decorative with empty alt.
Keep the tone helpful, never blaming.
